neighbours.label: the final digit '1' of the year 1861 (after '186')
fire: The siege of Fort Sumter in April 1861 opened the American Civil War.
Italy was formally unified as a kingdom in 1861 under Victor Emmanuel.
Tsar Alexander II freed the serfs of Russia in 1861 by decree.
By the summer of 1861 both armies were recruiting volunteers in every town.
The telegraph line across the continent was completed in 1861.
Kansas joined the Union as a free state early in 1861.
Prince Albert died at Windsor in December 1861 of typhoid fever.
Many letters written in 1861 describe the panic in the border states.
quiet: The siege of Vicksburg in May 1863 split the Confederacy in two.
Italy fought a short war against Austria in 1866 to gain Venetia.
Tsar Alexander II was assassinated in St Petersburg in 1881.
By the summer of 1862 both armies had suffered terrible losses.
The first transatlantic telegraph cable was laid in 1858.
Nevada joined the Union as a state late in 1864.
Queen Victoria celebrated her jubilee in London in 1887.
Many letters written in 1865 describe the relief at the war's end.
